name: Anole

review.observation: Full original: green slender anole with orange expanded throat dewlap, long continuous tail and four readable feet. Individual toe pads are small but visible; near/far upper limbs overlap at body roots, so separability is not fully established. The orange dewlap remains continuously attached beneath the throat; broad margins.

decisions.paintingObservation: No paired projecting mammalian pinnae are depicted. Any ear opening, tympanum, protective ear flap, casque, horn, neck frill or external gill remains natural head/neck paint; none is a substitute pinna.

policyStatus: AUDIT_ONLY_CANDIDATE: production reviewed-presence.mjs still admits tail absence only.
